title.ko: 뉴스 읽기와 말하기: 과거 수동태 · 전달 동사 · 의견
title.en: reading and discussing the news: past passive, reporting verbs, opinions

explain.ko: 뉴스는 과거 수동태(The fire was put out within an hour)와 현재 진행 수동태(The cause is being investigated)로 쓰는 경우가 많습니다. 누가 했는지가 중요하지 않을 때 수동태를 씁니다. 남의 말을 전할 때는 전달 동사(report, announce, say)를 쓰고(The mayor announced that ...), 의견과 사실을 구분해야 합니다. 사실은 evidence(증거)로 확인하고 믿을 만한 출처인지 살펴보세요.
explain.en: News texts often use the past passive (The fire was put out within an hour) and the present continuous passive (The cause is being investigated). Use the passive when the doer is not important. Report what people say with verbs such as report, announce and say (The mayor announced that ...), and tell facts from opinions. Check the evidence and whether the source is reliable.

prompt.ko: 최근에 읽은 뉴스나 기사를 소개하고 의견을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Introduce a news story you read recently and give your opinion in 4 sentences.

task.model: Yesterday I read an article about global warming. It was written by a famous journalist and based on many facts. But fake news can spread quickly, so I always check that the source is reliable. In my opinion, we need more articles like this. The mayor announced that the cause of the fire is being investigated, and the channel reported it.
